reviewScope: final integrated candidate; live deployment reviewed separately

visual.reason: Root reviewed the integrated composition and accepts the non-author commercial-v1 scores and original-frame material-motion-v1 verdict for this exact candidate; each of the three category totals is strictly above 9.

interaction.reason: Actual bilingual customer flow, validation, edit/recovery and UTF-8 local download passed. Concept-brand text distinguishes a local brief/selection from an order, payment or reservation.

shader.reason: Original CSS composites and independently read GPU textures show non-empty rendering. Controls and returned material/form states have same-candidate non-author review; evolving particle correctness is not inferred from pixel-drift ratios. No runtime or GPU validation errors. Associated raw RGBA, corrected transparent PNGs and fixed-black comparison PNGs are retained with alphaMode/dimension metadata.

lifecycle.reason: Supported initialization, denied/missing GPU, injected device loss with actual device destruction, pause/resume, hidden/offscreen and navigation recovery passed. Native controlled pause keeps the visible canvas/device/dimensions, no queue submissions during pointer challenge, and original-resolution frame stability; independent desktop/mobile quartets are retained.

accessibility.reason: Bilingual 320/390/768/1440 widths, 200% root text sizing, keyboard focus, touch-sized principal controls, no-JS/no-GPU and reduced-motion scenarios passed under the work-specific suite. Rendered reflow was independently checked. This is not a browser page-zoom or full human screen-reader audit.

performance.reason: Same-candidate build enforced <=2 MiB gzip per route including lazy chunks; browser reports record real canvas dimensions/acquisitions and one canvas, with hidden/offscreen/reduced-motion stopping work. Software renderer observations are not physical-device FPS or battery proof. The 30fps/DPR design targets are not misrepresented as a universal SDK cap.

privacy.reason: Pinned standalone source and emitted bundle disable telemetry. Same-candidate browser interception found only approved same-origin static GETs, no fetch/XHR/beacon/socket, storage/cookies or CSP violations; runtime assets/fonts are local. Pages uses meta CSP, not claimed response headers.

seo.reason: The same-candidate build verifies readable bilingual HTML, unique title/description/h1, canonical and reciprocal hreflang, local sharing assets, noindex candidate pages, base paths and 404. Public indexing and exact deployed source receipt are checked separately during release.

reproducibility.reason: All eight exact-candidate Windows jobs completed clean pinned npm ci, source checks, 20 unit tests, build and their browser lane; aggregate job 131723689722 passed. Artifact digest/size/CRC and original files are retained. This candidate gate does not claim the later live deployment or delivery ZIP has happened.

artDirection.reason: 鈷藍、粉白和橘色粒子與工作室識別、案例形成一致品牌。
大字與立體粒子主次明確，手機仍保留主行動和三形態入口。
同候選雙語標題、服務與流程層級清楚；桌面大字與手機 FAQ 排版沒有新增孤字或溢出。
同候選原尺寸三形態及26秒合成序列中，Identity後下緣、Motion近遠環段與Digital薄扭帶空隙可辨，手機亮度及密度保留深度。
案例寬窄交錯、服務與流程區節奏完整；手機保留形體輪廓。

uiDesign.reason: 品牌定位、案例、三服務與需求摘要的閱讀及決策順序清楚。
主CTA、服務預填、三形態與觸控等效散開入口清楚，位置一致。
必填選擇、交付項目、檢視、返回編輯與下載具明確狀態；本SHA報告驗證資料一致。
390px原圖清楚；同SHA報告的雙語320/390/768/1440空白與已選表單在100%/200%根文字放大無溢出，完成摘要另有320px量測。鍵盤與觸控依隔離runner報告，非人工逐一操作或瀏覽器整頁縮放測試。
服務、表單、摘要與真TXT一致；手機散開回聚及暫停提供清楚狀態。

commercialCompleteness.reason: 識別、動態與數位體驗三種服務和預期產出明確。
交付範圍、價格、週期、兩輪修改與費用說明支持選擇，概念案例展示應用。
案例明示概念；摘要與TXT明示本機產生、尚未聯絡工作室。
方案預填、必填和交付驗證、返回編輯及雙語真實下載依同SHA報告成立。
完成摘要和TXT一致、編輯入口清楚；本季內仍是相對時程文字，無新增阻擋。

views.reason: 逐張檢視本候選11張自然原合成、三種形態與返回，以及散開回聚。環體後下緣、螺旋近遠環段和薄扭帶空隙在原尺寸可辨，未見新增輪廓或體積退步；判斷依實際形態而非僅像素有變化。
views.timeQualification: seconds逐項取自本候選natural.startedMs，為實際capture開始時間，非GPU精確呈現時間或FPS；evolving不宣稱粒子位置具有完全閉合週期。

semanticControls.reason: 已聯合檢視同候選原始頁面合成與經正確straight-alpha編碼的GPU texture：identity環體→motion螺旋→digital薄扭帶→identity返回，每個狀態各有不同實際擷取檔。這是獨立形態審查，未以稀疏點集的像素漂移比率代替。

sequence.observedShape: 橘色粒子構成有清楚中央開口的環體；近側較亮、後下緣較暗，原頁面合成與texture都可辨環狀體積。
環體轉為向上延伸的三圈螺旋，圈與圈之間保留空隙，可辨近側和遠側的環段。
螺旋轉為粉白色斜向薄扭帶，可辨曲面折轉、細長邊緣及中間負空間，並非原環體只換色。
返回橘色環體與中央開口，螺旋的分圈和薄扭帶輪廓消失；粒子位置持續演變，不要求回到相同像素。

pauseVerification.qualification: 手機before/action/1000ms原PNG完全一致；桌面33個像素有1階色值差，mean0.00005206982465240936，符合既有mean≤0.01、peak≤1限制，不能宣稱桌面PNG完全一致。兩者零queue提交、同canvas且續播恢復實際合成變化。

textureEncoding.pngAlphaEncoding: straight alpha; display RGB unpremultiplied and clamped to RGBA8

naturalPauseVerification.qualification: 專屬lane paused/held原PNG一致且acquisition不增加，支持暫停保持；自然before與paused時刻不同，不作瞬間同幀判定。正式凍結證據另用本SHA shared原合成quartet。

views.capturePairing: GPU readback與頁面合成依控制狀態配對，並非同一次GPU submission。same-frame pause判定只比較受控時鐘未推進期間及暫停1000ms後的原始合成。

limitations: 本候選的專屬雙語頁面、顧客流程、自然序列、三形態與返回及shared桌面/手機凍結證據已複核。本檔只批准V005設計與材質動作審查；九項release gates與正式部署由主責另核，未宣稱live已驗。

shared桌面頁面1100×850，canvas634×537，實際合成clip633×536；手機頁面390×844，canvas與合成351×285。桌面before/action及action/held有33個像素1階色值微差（mean0.00005206982465240936），在既有mean≤0.01/peak≤1限制內，不是byte-identical；手機before/action/held原PNG完全相同。
shared手機僅驗證暫停前演變、同幀凍結及續播，沒有A/A/B/A。桌面evolving像素差是診斷資料，其REQUIRES_INDEPENDENT_FORM_REVIEW由本候選專lane原合成/texture三形態及返回的semanticControls審查補足，不以像素變化代表形態正確。
GPU readback與原頁面合成相鄰擷取、依控制狀態配對，不宣稱相同GPU submission；GPU submittedAt也不是實體顯示器呈現時間。自然序列秒數為capture起點，acquisition不是FPS。
雙語四寬空白/已選表單的200%根文字放大、320px完成摘要、鍵盤、驗證與回編依本SHA報告及獨立子審查；不擴稱四寬摘要或整頁200%zoom均測。實體GPU、實體手機、人工讀屏及正式live NOT_RUN。
